{{Top|leg}}
'''Recon Company''' was a military unit of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]], trained by [[Gavon Kroan]]. Stationed at the [[Drift Hills Republic depot]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], Kroan send the First Squad of the Company on a routine check into nearby caves, where the men were overwhelmed and captured in frozen ice by the [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]]. When the men did not return in time, Kroan got worried and asked a skilled Republic operative to rescue the soldiers. Thanks to his timely actions, all men were returned to base safely.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Frozen Search and Rescue|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>
